en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e Bin Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one with sexual impurity should pour the water upon his head, three times, any less than that would not suffice him’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Rib‘i ibn ‘Abd Allah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One, because of sexual relation, must pour water on one’s head three times. Less than this is not sufficient.’”
